sentences.text:
on 25 March, 2021
 Ablapl No.657 of 2021
4. 25.3.2021 The petitioner apprehending his arrest in
 Kantabanji P.S. Case No.13 of 2021 corresponding
 to G.R. Case No.30 of 2021 pending in the court of
 J.M.F.C., Kantabanji registered for alleged
 commission of offence punishable under Sections
 272/273/420/269/270 Ipc read with Sections
 51/53/54/59/61/63 of the Food Safety and
 Standards Act and Section 3 of the Epidemic
 Diseases Act and Sections 32/36 of the Legal
 Metrology Act has filed this petition for his release
 on pre-arrest bail.

Learned counsel for the State submits  that examination report of food articles seized in  the aforesaid case has not been received from the  Food Safety Officer, Bolangir in spite of the  persuasion of the I.O.
This is a case of anticipatory bail in a  serious offence like food adulteration.
Examination  report of the sample, which is vital piece of  evidence, is required for effective adjudication of the  ABLAPL.
In spite of that fact and for reasons best  known the Food Safety Officer, Bolangir has not  furnished the report.

In such premises, this Court directs that  this order be communicated to the Secretary,
 Health and Family Welfare Department,
 Government of Odisha, to impart necessary  instruction for early examination of the food articles  2  which are seized in connection with food  adulteration cases.
Furthermore, the I.O in this  case is directed to proceed against the Food Safety  Officer, Bolangir, if he fails to provide the  examination report in the manner known to law.
A copy of this order be sent to the  Collector, Bolangir and S.P., Bolangir for  information and necessary action.
Free copy of this order be handed over to  the learned Addl.

Standing Counsel appearing for  the State to transmit the same to the Secretary,
ABLAPL/657/2021 on 25 March, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92090031/
1  Health and Family Welfare Department, Collector,
 Bolangir and S.P., Bolangir and the I.O concerned.
 ..........................

PKS S.Pujahari, J.
